Dead Cat Bounce is a short-lived rebound in the price of a falling asset. Dead Cat Bounce occurs after a significant price decline. Dead Cat Bounce is typically followed by a resumption of the downward trend.

Dead Coin is a cryptocurrency whose development and community activity have ceased. Dead Coin is no longer actively traded or maintained. Dead Coin has little or no remaining market value.

death spiral is a self-reinforcing cycle in which falling prices trigger further selling. death spiral is typically driven by a loss of confidence that leads to redemptions or sales. death spiral can end in a collapse in the value of an asset.

Vesting schedule is a predefined timetable that sets when allocated tokens become available to their holders. Vesting schedule may include a cliff period during which no tokens are released. Vesting schedule releases tokens gradually over time, and large unlocks can create selling pressure.
